map.内能变化（ΔU = Q − W） 使用指南: Internal energy change (deltaU = Q - W) user guide
map.热力学第一定律计算器：输入系统吸热量 Q 与对外做功 W，按 ΔU = Q −: First law of thermodynamics calculator: enter heat absorbed Q and work done W by the system, and compute the internal energy change by deltaU = Q - W, for energy-balance analysis.
map.系统内能变化等于吸热量减去对外做功。: The system's internal energy change equals heat absorbed minus work done.
map.闭口系统能量守恒 ΔU=Q−W。: Closed-system energy conservation deltaU = Q - W.
map.吸热/做功下的内能变化。: Internal energy change under heat absorption/work.
map.与稳流能量方程区分。: Distinguish from the steady-flow energy equation.
map.：Q=1000 J, W=400 J：ΔU=Q−W=1000−400=600 J: : Q = 1000 J, W = 400 J: deltaU = Q - W = 1000 - 400 = 600 J, internal energy increases.
map.：Q=0, W=−500（外界对系）：ΔU=500 J 升温。: : Q = 0, W = -500 (work done on system): deltaU = 500 J, temperature rises.
map.自然对流驱动力无量纲数: Dimensionless number for natural-convection driving force
map.约定系统对外做功为正，则 ΔU=Q−W；不同教材符号可能相反。: Convention: work done by the system is positive, so deltaU = Q - W; some textbooks use the opposite sign.
map.闭口系（质量不变）；开口稳流用焓形式。: Closed system (constant mass); open steady flow uses the enthalpy form.
